Maria: Quick question — for console quick-save (the little floppy in the top bar), should the default scope be per-route, per-model, or 'smart' (telemetry-driven)?
Kevin: My vote: smart default. Most teams change it once, but first impression matters.
Sajal: Smart sounds nice but expensive to implement. What signals? model pin, recent route hits, token cost?
Ana: telemetry signals we could use: route traffic %, dominant model in last 7d, and sample-rate. If dominant model >70% -> default per-model.
Tyler: Also consider quota surface: if saved query defaults per-model we might show a cost-preview different than per-route. Need clarity.
Maria: Exactly — UX should surface quota impact inline. Maybe a subtle badge: "Cost preview: ~2.3k tokens / run" next to save button.
Kevin: +1 for inline cost. Also, if user toggles scope, we should show which teams/owners will get access (simple list or "private to you").
Sajal: Implementation note: backend API would need to accept scope + telemetry hint. Proposed payload: ```json
{
  "name": "My saved query",
  "query": "route:checkout model:gptx-3",
  "scope": "auto", // values: auto|route|model|org
  "telemetry_context": {"dominant_model":"gptx-3","route_pct":87} 
}
```
Ana: Hmm, passing telemetry_context from client seems wrong (spoofable). Better: client sends scope=auto and the server resolves and returns preview metadata.
Tyler: Agreed. Server-side resolution avoids inconsistencies. Client only asks for scope=auto then GET /savedquery/preview returns predicted scope + cost estimate.
Maria: UX workflow: click quick-save -> modal with resolved default scope + small "why this default" hint (e.g., "Most traffic on this route used gptx-3 last 7d") and cost delta. Can we make that hint subtle? Maybe a tooltip.
Kevin: For rollouts, we should also show if the saved query will be used by canary routing rules. I.e., saved queries tied to a route should be visible to routing config owners.
Sajal: Permission mapping question: If scope=model and model is pinned to route A, should users on route B see it? I think no unless cross-route share is explicit.
Ana: Tied to the policy doc — default behavior: model-scoped saves are visible to teams with model access; route-scoped saves visible to route owners. Cross-share requires explicit share checkbox.
Tyler: Telemetry note: when we resolve scope=auto, record the decision + signals used (for audit). Helps evals and A/B tweaks.
Maria: Good call. Also, add a small "preview traffic" chart in the modal to justify cost estimate. Tiny sparkline.
Kevin: Edge-case: ephemeral preview sessions where sample-rate is low -> we might default wrong. Suggest a fallback: if sample_count < 200 -> ask user to pick explicit scope.
Sajal: Implementation plan: backend resolver service that looks at model usage, route metadata, and token burn per sample. Expose endpoint: POST /api/v1/savedqueries/resolve with body {route_id, user_id, scope:auto}. Respond with {resolved_scope, cost_estimate, rationale}.
Ana: We'll need telemetry team signoff for exposing model usage signals to the resolver. Add to roadmap.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch 'quicksave-scope-resolver' — CI passed :white_check_mark:
Maria: Ok let's file a tiny RFC and get product + telemetry + infra alignment. I'll draft and ping y'all. :sparkles:
